The {{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}} allows you to bypass the normally winding and circuitous path through the [[swamp]] and reach the [[clotho|witch's hut]] much faster.

It can take a substantial amount of {{energy}} to build the bridge and because of the long trip it's recommended to fill up your energy bar before leaving.
